question: Does the retrieved example suppress discovery, or is the miss present without selected examples too?
fixedFactors: Exact user-reviewed stored transcript segment IDs and text
CandidateReviewEngine implementation and shared system prompt hash
Global review guidelines and their runtime bytes
Genre, reading-window construction, output schema, budgets, and verification features
No video, audio, OCR, frame, or image input

conditions.description: Keep all guideline/pattern rows and reproduce the prior selected example; verify the preflight selection trace before any model call.
Keep the same global guideline/pattern rows and prompt contract; maxExamples=0 omits selected example contexts from the model payload. Verify the request payload hash before any model call.

stopOn: Any hash drift in source, runtime guidelines, prompt implementation, or model configuration
Any API/schema/budget failure or output payload containing expected labels

interpretation.currentMissAndNoExamplesMiss: No evidence that the selected example caused the miss; investigate discovery criteria next.
interpretation.currentMissButNoExamplesFinds: Evidence that the selected example may be interfering; not proof of causality from this small trial.
interpretation.inconsistentWithinCondition: Treat as unstable; do not promote the case or change shared prompts based on this run.
interpretation.currentFindsAndNoExamplesMiss: The selected example may help this excerpt; do not generalize from D05 alone.

doNotAddD05ToRuntimeBefore: A normal contrast for criticism of rank/promotion standards is reviewed and recorded
The case entry separates criticism of a system from demeaning practitioners as a group
The reference-isolation result and D02/D04 regression controls are reviewed
